headline: During a live database outage, /status/ opened on 'All Systems Operational' before its probes returned. It now waits for every check, names a provider outage as one, and says the site is up.

items.title: /status/ tells a provider outage from a site fault
items.insight: The banner summarised a partial result set, so every load opened green for ~5s; a gateway 401 also counted as a live database. It now shows 'Checking services... (n of 7)', accepts only database-origin refusals, adds an Auth row, and derives 'Database Provider Outage' with a plain note on what is affected.
items.evidence: timed probe 300/1500/4000ms Checking (2 of 7), 6500ms Database Provider Outage, 0 page errors; rendered-pixel pass dark/light/high-contrast at desktop and mobile

items.title: The leaderboard embed is readable on any host page
items.insight: The board's S356 premise (hard-coded greys) was stale; the live defect was host theme tokens painted over the widget's own near-black ground, 1.9 / 2.6:1 on our light theme. Literal palette, unit-enforced.
items.evidence: #a8b4d0 9.5:1, #8b9bc9 ~7:1 on #0a0a0a; unit test rejects var(-- in the widget

items.title: build-shell-assets is import-safe and tested
items.insight: Importing the module ran the whole build and rewrote every page, so its predicate helper could carry no test. Guarded; 7 unit tests; a negative control fails when the guard is removed.
items.evidence: tests/shell-assets.unit.spec.js 7/7; unit-suite parity 18/18/18; build:check all steps passed

items.title: Two open board items closed as already fixed
items.insight: The IGNIS chip and drift-preflight items were fixed in S357 but still open; verified against the code and closed with file references rather than re-worked.
